name: Mirror Shield
description: Polished to a perfect mirror finish, this shield reflects light, magic, and energy beams. Essential for Twinrova fight and Spirit Temple puzzles.

customData.lore: Polished by the Gerudo's finest artisans using silver from the Spirit Temple. It reflects not just light, but magic itself.
puzzleUses: Absorb 3 fire + 3 ice -> reflect combined beam
Reflect light beams in mirror puzzles
Break Light Barrier with Light Arrows
